$Comment: The jar's own flat Voidheart roll (RPG Stations' Disenchant_Void carries it beside the Void essence), moved into a table of its own because this pack's same-id Disenchant_Void now holds only the Void essence, gated for Kit Rite; the Voidheart is not a Void find, so Kit Rite keeps it.
